items.title: Will Shade and Dewey Corley Interview, 1960-05-25
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Did you ever see this show, Mike and Mike? Never did. Never did.

ctx.x: Oh, she was doing that strippy dance, you know, doing all that hollalula stuff and twisting and going on. when she went back on all forward backwards, stripped down, stripped down, stripped to the last piece. And she didn't know it. She was come to find out all the pieces were all with none of them on there. And they said, do it again, she couldn't find it. There was nothing there to do it with.
Did you ever see this show, Mike and Mike? Never did. Never did. She used to be with them. She was a dancer. What did she sing herself?
I don't know. I never did hear.
